pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sūpampi odanampi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sūpampi odanampi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ. vipācentānaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.9: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sūpampi odanampi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.10: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave sūpampi odanampi attano atthāya viññāpetvā
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.16.1: “na sūpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:1.17: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū gilānā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.4: pubbe mayaṃ āvuso sūpampi odanampi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjāma. tena no phāsu hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.6: bhagavatā paṭikkhittanti kukkuccāyantā na viññāpema tena no na phāsu hotīti. bhikkhū
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.7: bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhu āmantesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.8: “anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā sūpampi odanampi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjituṃ”
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.9: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.10.1: “na sūpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.11: na sūpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā agilānena attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk37:2.12: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sūpaṃ vā odanaṃ vā agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
